description: Every model some live free offer serves (the data behind aifree.dev/model and GET /api/v1/models), most free sources first: slug, family, vendor, context window, tool calling, vision, JSON mode, open weights and how many free sources serve it. Filter by name, family, provider, capability or minimum context; then call get_model for the sources and rate limits.

minContextK.description: Minimum context window in thousands of tokens, e.g. 128

provider.description: Substring of a source provider, offer name or offer slug, e.g. "groq"

query.description: Substring of the model slug, name or a source model name

toolCalling.description: true = only models with tool calling

name: list_models
title: List models in the free catalog
